body:
Ledger [#25 / draft #26](https://github.com/Waveframe-Labs/Waveframe-Ledger/pull/26#issuecomment-5656686291) resolves the three combined-gate failures. Its exact 0.9.0 candidate passes all four Windows/Linux × Python 3.10/3.14 base/combined cells with the accepted Guard #51 wheel. Guard must now consume that Ledger candidate, correct its README minimum, and produce green required CI and fresh combined evidence for its own final wheel.

This is a **Guard-only release-coordination change**, not a new execution feature.

## Base and approved inputs

Create a new branch and stacked draft PR targeting **`feat/50-guard-019-release` at `0161ef8a52e052d1bc1366cdc93ce13a9bd535ed`** (draft #51). Preserve #45/#47/#49/#51 and their tested heads/evidence.

| Component | Exact source |
| --- | --- |
| Guard base #51 | `0161ef8a52e052d1bc1366cdc93ce13a9bd535ed` |
| Ledger #26 | `a34c11d81b85963794cf28b4adad091fac15e130` |
| Compiler #8 | `ae590dee058d3481e384dea850d5b7d980f533ff` |
| Ledger durable evidence | `46cd4c5a9a2c17e2367d64b56803df92de69d8b3` |
| Retained catalog-2 Cloud regression server #147 | `547291b525e2f1d05d92ed65b6058c4ca91588a8` |
| Later Cloud catalog-3 handoff #151 | `8552aad2fc4fcf861cc2205ebce70a5b486534e6` |

Use Ledger's [immutable handoff, package hashes and archives](https://github.com/Waveframe-Labs/Waveframe-Ledger/tree/46cd4c5a9a2c17e2367d64b56803df92de69d8b3). Four files under `artifacts/issue25-*-a34c11d81b85963794cf28b4adad091fac15e130.zip` contain the actual Ledger wheel/sdist, Compiler wheel, base/combined evidence, hashes and source/archive provenance. Verify the selected archive against the handoff and retained checksums before use.

Reference Ubuntu/Python 3.14 Ledger wheel SHA-256: **6b7913e4ba4e2b11d1007bb3006dea81cde08ebc06980a7bab89113938779bd4**; sdist: **8ceb328437c794a3306d22ca82e99787f3bf4ff0d0281b4e245d7d0b29c42c2c**. Use each environment's recorded artifacts/provenance or explicitly document a verified equivalent selection; do not infer source identity from version alone.

Version stays **Guard 0.19.0 / proposed v0.19.0**, runtime Ledger **>=0.9.0,<0.10.0**, test/development Compiler **>=0.5.0,<0.6.0**. Existing CRI/Normalizer/requests bounds remain unchanged.

## Required changes

1. Update new-client and validation-tool references from Ledger #24 to exact #26 throughout active candidate requirements, CI checkouts, acceptance tools, provenance expectations and handoff documentation. Preserve original fixture-generation provenance, historical evidence, older Cloud server dependency pins, and explicit catalog-2 development flags. New-client fixture reproduction must still prove unchanged canonical outputs.

2. Correct README's statement that the new Guard tests Ledger 0.7 as its minimum. The release candidate requires Ledger 0.9; older package pairs remain clearly historical. Keep unreleased status and install/publication/activation limits accurate.

3. Adapt Guard's `tools/acceptance/ledger_guard_extra.py` and workflow to run genuine combined acceptance with **the newly built current Guard wheel**, the accepted Ledger #26 wheel, and Compiler #8. Preserve required producer failures; remove obsolete failure-only follow-up assumptions once the actual full gate passes.

### Important acceptance-interface decision

Ledger #26 changed `run_guard_extra_acceptance.py` from `--guard-candidate` to **`--verified-inputs`**. Its `fetch_guard_candidate.py` deliberately authenticates the immutable **old Guard #51** artifact. Passing the newly built Guard manifest to the old CLI will fail; rerunning that fixed-input Ledger command only proves the old Guard artifact again.

**Keep Ledger source and this original evidence unchanged.** In Guard's own thin wrapper, reuse Ledger #26's unchanged packaged suites, `Acceptance.suites`/probe helpers and `check_installed_wheel_set.py` / `package_provenance.py` against the current Guard wheel. Restore support files from the verified Ledger sdist without importing Ledger checkout source. Guard owns authentication of its current clean build: actual checkout head, build record, expected wheel hash and installed bytes. Supply the provenance expectations explicitly, with verified Ledger/Compiler archive origins and actual pip install reports.

Do not monkeypatch Ledger's pinned verifier, forge `verified-inputs.json`, relabel the old Guard archive as the new head, copy an alternate version of Ledger's tests, or create another policy/evaluation implementation. The reviewed Ledger #26 + Guard #51 results remain valid historical input evidence. The new required result must name and validate the current Guard artifact.

Use the accepted Ledger/Compiler archives for this combined gate. Other existing Guard source/installed checks may build dependencies from the exact commits; record those origins separately and verify installed runtime/resource equivalence where they are used to support the same release set. A Git installation or a previously passing source suite must not stand in for the real combined wheel-set installation.

## Required final-head validation

Run the existing Guard matrix on **Windows/Linux × Python 3.10/3.14**, updating workflow branch triggers for the stacked base and checking out the actual PR head.

- Complete existing Guard source/default/development and clean-installed/package suites. All **150 release cases** must execute in each required suite; default/development/platform skips retain their existing meaning. Preserve canonical fixtures, v1/v2/v3/v4 historical behavior, per-action grants, identities and truthful operation evidence.
- Build fresh Guard wheel/sdist, verify metadata/resources/public API/CLI/examples and `pip check`, and record exact archive hashes. Confirm installed modules come from the intended environments.
- Run the unchanged Ledger #26 full combined default and development suites against the **current Guard wheel**. The reviewed baseline is **678 passed / 0 failed / 44 skipped** default and **722 / 0 / 0** development. Require all 70 release cases, all 44 opted-in development cases, every optional integration, the mediated v3 example, release/development package checks and all 56 real catalog-3 execution probes.
- Verify both ordinary Ledger `[guard]` and Guard installation paths through normal resolution using actual candidate archives. Rerun the existing Guard-entry upgrade from released packages and old-Ledger resolver rejection with the new set; retain actual resolution failure reasons, versions, origins, installed bytes and successful `pip check`. No `--no-deps`, fabricated distributions, metadata relabelling or old-runtime fallback.
- Execute all **23 real connected cases in each environment / 92 total** against unchanged Cloud #147 using the already configured read-only `CLOUD_TEST_READ_TOKEN`. Preserve independent server/client provenance. Credential skips are not passes. This is retained catalog-2 regression acceptance, not final Cloud catalog-3/Console acceptance.
- Retain #51's reviewed same-device bind-mount run and its exact tested-wheel identity. For this metadata/docs/harness-only change, compare the installed filesystem/enforcement files and relevant mount-test inputs with #51 and record byte equivalence and the proof's scope. Do not claim a new wheel was mount-tested if it was not. If any relevant implementation/dependency behavior changes, fresh real mount acceptance is required; unavailable/skipped is not passed.
- Retain output and nonzero status from failed required producers. All final-head required jobs must execute and pass; queued, skipped or earlier-head jobs do not qualify.

No new execution feature or broad implementation refactor belongs in this task. If you find a necessary Ledger runtime change, report the concrete defect for coordination; do not modify sibling source to make Guard green.

## Evidence and downstream handoff

Preserve a durable evidence bundle beyond CI expiry with:

- Exact new Guard head/base, Ledger/Compiler heads, unchanged Cloud regression-server identity, actual commands and exit codes.
- Current Guard wheel/sdist plus the actual accepted Ledger/Compiler archives used together, hashes, source/build provenance, import/resource checks and install/upgrade reports.
- Four-cell Guard, full combined and real connected results, expected skips, exact final-head CI links, and scoped mount evidence/equivalence.
- A single clear package-set manifest for Cloud that distinguishes this current validated set from older #49/#51/#24 evidence.

Return the stacked draft PR and this handoff. The next implementation belongs to **Cloud**, which must consume the reviewed final set and complete package/Console/production-image acceptance on top of #151. Do not alter or activate Cloud from this task.

Keep `release_ready=false` pending final coordination. No merge, tag, GitHub release, package upload, deployment or customer activation is authorized. Release order remains **Compiler 0.5.0 → Ledger 0.9.0 → Guard 0.19.0**, ordinary index checks, then separately authorized Cloud rollout/activation. Deletion, rename and macOS remain subsequent scope.
title: release: repin Ledger 0.9 candidate and validate the final Guard 0.19 wheel set
